title: explosion is not a punch: deflect only melee damage
changed: src/main/java/dev/minemod/entity/ShellbackEntity.java (+21/-1): canDeflect accepts only melee damage types, isMeleeAttack whitelist, redundant projectile branch removed
src/gametest/java/dev/minemod/test/ShellbackCombatGameTest.java (+64): case creeper_front_damages, plus a timing fix in creative_player_is_targeted
cause: Explosion#getDefaultDamageSource resolves a living explosion source through getIndirectSourceEntity, which answers the creeper itself, so a blast reached canDeflect as direct == causing == creeper and every shape check matched a punch
hypothesis_corrected: The coordinator's pre-dispatch hypothesis (blast arrives with a null direct entity, so the defect is probably not reproducible) was wrong; the executor disproved it from 26.3 bytecode and by experiment. Recorded here on purpose: the gate is an experiment, not the orchestrator's reading of the code.
harness_fix: creative_player_is_targeted used to assert the target at tick 20, but the target goal rescans on a randomised 10-tick interval, so it failed once in eight runs. The wait is now 40 ticks; three consecutive clean builds were green.
not_verified: manual in-client step: creeper strictly in front, then strictly behind
explosion from behind has no separate case: after the fix the damage type decides, so the side no longer matters
